use_case: AI Assist: generative reply drafting for customers' agents in the agent workspace (summaries, suggested replies, tone changes)
vendor_or_model: AI model provider API (SYS-10): standard endpoint for most tenants, zero-retention endpoint under a BAA for the healthcare cell; company-built prompts and tenant-scoped retrieval
data_categories: Ticket text, conversation history, knowledge base passages, end-consumer first names; PHI in the healthcare cell
human_in_the_loop: Agent reviews, edits, and sends every reply; nothing is sent automatically
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N51-R01); customer DPA and CCPA service-provider terms (N51-R03); HIPAA as a business associate for the healthcare cell (subcontractor BAA with the model provider)
status: In production (generally available since 2026-03, about 1,100 customers); approved with conditions 2026-09-29

use_case: Answer Bot: customer-facing generative chatbot that answers end consumers from the customer's help center and hands off to agents
vendor_or_model: AI model provider API (standard endpoint); company-built retrieval, grounding check, and handoff rules
data_categories: End-consumer questions, conversation history, knowledge base passages
consequential_decision_category: None (answers questions; takes no account actions). Re-tier if account actions are enabled
risk_tier: High (company rule: autonomous replies to end consumers)
human_in_the_loop: No human review per message; handoff to an agent on request, on low confidence, or on sensitive topics
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N51-R01), including the product page claim (P03 G-045); customer DPA and CCPA service-provider terms (N51-R03); CPPA ADMT rules and Colorado SB26-189 considered and not triggered while no consequential decisions are made; not enabled in the healthcare cell
status: Beta (85 customers since 2026-06); continues in grounded-only mode; no new customers until thresholds are met

use_case: Ticket triage classifier: predicts priority, topic, and sentiment for routing
vendor_or_model: Company-built classification model trained on the company's own support tickets and synthetic tickets (no customer data used for training)
consequential_decision_category: None (routing); agents and admins can override
human_in_the_loop: Agents and customer administrators can change priority and routing; rules can override the model
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N51-R01); customer DPA (inference only on customer data; no training on it); CPPA ADMT rules considered and not triggered
status: In production since 2024 (all tenants, opt-out available); approved with conditions 2026-09-29

use_case: Enterprise AI coding assistant for engineers
vendor_or_model: Enterprise generative AI coding assistant (SaaS; no training on inputs)
data_categories: Source code and comments; customer data and secrets not allowed
human_in_the_loop: Engineers review every suggestion; normal code review applies
applicable_laws: FTC Act Section 5 (N51-R01) indirectly through secure development; POL-05 4.8 approved tools list

use_case: Meeting and call summarizer for sales and customer support calls
vendor_or_model: Meeting summarizer (SaaS; no training on inputs)
data_categories: Call audio and transcripts with customers and prospects; customer configuration details discussed on calls
human_in_the_loop: Staff review summaries before they are saved to the CRM
applicable_laws: Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) all-party consent; other states' recording laws (counsel applies the all-party rule to every call); FTC Act Section 5 (N51-R01); POL-05 4.9
status: In use since 2025 (about 200 users); approved with conditions 2026-09-29 (auto-join off; consent at start of every call)
